Presale means you buy a home before it is built, and you take possession when it completes. This page lists every Coquitlam presale project on my list that is scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2029, with the developer, type, size and deposit where the sources publish them.
New homes listed on the MLS® now in Coquitlam

The listings above are the active MLS® new-construction listings in Coquitlam, picked by setting the board's age field to 0 or less: homes completed this year and homes listed before they are finished. Land and income properties are excluded; houses, townhomes and condos are in. Developers sell most presale homes themselves and list them on the MLS® late, if at all. Treat the search as the MLS® slice of new construction.
What newer homes in Coquitlam have sold for
In November 2025 to October 2026, duplexes in Maillardville had the newest stock of any Coquitlam sub-area with enough sales to measure: median build year 2026, 21 sales, median price $1,285,000.

7 of 42 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Maillardville duplexes (built 2026), Scott Creek townhomes (built 2026), Central Coquitlam duplexes (built 2025) and Coquitlam West duplexes (built 2025).

blocks.text: Coquitlam presale projects at a glance

The list holds 21 presale projects in Coquitlam with estimated completion between 2027 and 2029: 11 in 2027, 9 in 2028, 1 in 2029. By type, that is 11 condo projects, 5 mixed condo and townhome projects, 4 townhome projects, 1 house project.
None of the 21 has a price I can show with a recent date, so ask me for the current price list.
A deposit structure is published for 9 of the 21.
Developers with more than one project here: Beedie Living (3), Polygon Homes (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Elmwood at 333 homes.

faq.q: How many presale projects are completing in Coquitlam between 2027 and 2029?
faq.a: 21 projects are on my list as of November 2026: 11 completing in 2027, 9 completing in 2028, 1 completing in 2029. The list covers projects marketed publicly. Projects sold only through private channels may be missing.

faq.q: What kinds of presale homes are being built in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The mix is 11 condo projects, 5 mixed condo and townhome projects, 4 townhome projects, 1 house project.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Coquitlam Presale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Coquitlam Presale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.
